Summarize this technical documentation in 2-3 sentences:

The authentication system uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) for all client applications. Access tokens have a 15-minute lifetime and are automatically refreshed using the refresh token, which expires after 30 days. Token revocation is handled through a Redis-backed blacklist that is checked on every request. Rate limiting is applied at 100 requests per minute per user, with burst capacity of 150 requests.
